# NEOM Panels — Corporate & Active Brand Reference (llms-full.txt)

Website: https://neompanels-new.vercel.app
Company Name: NEOM Panels
Descriptor: NEOM Panels is an Indian panel manufacturing company and the company behind Starwoods and NEOM Packing Plywood.
Brand Promise: Engineered Excellence, Designed for Spaces.
Contact: +91 97454 50618 | neompanels@gmail.com

## 1. Purpose, Vision, Mission & Values
- **Purpose**: To make buying panel materials more dependable and transparent.
- **Vision**: To be a trusted name in panel materials, known for dependable choices, transparent business practices and lasting customer relationships.
- **Mission**: To bring together manufacturing expertise, focused product brands, clear communication and accountable support to help customers choose and source materials with confidence.
- **Values**:
  - **Clarity**: Help customers understand the material options and the information relevant to their requirement.
  - **Accountability**: Stay involved when questions or problems arise and work towards an appropriate resolution.
  - **Dependability**: Communicate clearly about orders, delivery expectations and changes.
  - **Relationships**: Remain available beyond the initial transaction.
  - **Responsible progress**: Build a thoughtful approach to materials, resource use and people as the company develops.

## 2. Active Brands
- **Starwoods** (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/starwoods`): Plywood and engineered boards, including MDF and HDHMR where available in the current range.
- **NEOM Packing Plywood** (`https://neompanels-new.vercel.app/brands/neom-packing-plywood`): Plywood for industrial packaging requirements (packing cases, crates/enclosures, dividers/liners; Moisture Resistant MR packaging grade).

## 3. Customer Groups Served
- Dealers & Distributors
- Builders & Interior Contractors
- Furniture Manufacturers
- Industrial Packaging Businesses
- Government & Institutional Buyers
